verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a terminal and SSH/Mosh client with a local command set and small Python/Lua scripts, so recurring automation is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no scheduler, cron-like facility, or recurring workflow feature. Running one-off commands or scripts by hand is not a recurring schedule and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
